explanation: VHSNC (Village Health, Sanitation and Nutrition Committee): NHM 2005 में स्थापित — ग्राम स्तरीय स्वास्थ्य शासन। संरचना: 15 सदस्य — Ward Member (Chairperson), ASHA (Secretary), AWW, शिक्षित युवा, 2 महिला सदस्य, SC/ST प्रतिनिधि, ASHA facilitator। कार्य: (1) Village Health Plan तैयार करना, (2) Untied Fund ₹10,000/year manage करना (VHSNC + Gram Panchayat joint), (3) VHND (Village Health and Nutrition Day) आयोजन, (4) IDSP निगरानी — बीमारी की रिपोर्टिंग, (5) स्वच्छता निरीक्षण, (6) मृत्यु और जन्म पंजीकरण सहायता। NHSRC ने VHSNC operational guidelines जारी की हैं। चुनौतियाँ: नियमित बैठकें नहीं, fund utilization कम, elite capture।

question: भारत में 'National Tobacco Control Programme (NTCP)' की जिला-स्तरीय implementation में HEO की क्या भूमिका है?

options.text: NTCP — केवल IEC posters लगाना है
NTCP: COTPA enforcement support, Tobacco Cessation Centres (TCC), school-based awareness, quit line (1800-11-2356), data collection (GATS/GYTS), district tobacco cell — HEO इन सबका coordinator है
NTCP — Police Department द्वारा implement होता है
NTCP — केवल urban areas में चलता है

explanation: National Tobacco Control Programme (NTCP) 2007-08: District Tobacco Control Cell (DTCC) में HEO की केंद्रीय भूमिका। Components: (1) COTPA 2003 enforcement — 100m school zone, public places ban, labelling — awareness campaign; (2) Tobacco Cessation Centres (TCC): NHM-linked DHs/PHCs में; (3) School programmes: Global Youth Tobacco Survey (GYTS) data, student awareness, (4) IEC: MPOWER strategy के अनुसार — Warning labels, public awareness, (5) Quit Line: 1800-11-2356 (national), (6) GATS (Global Adult Tobacco Survey) data utilization. HEO role: (1) School health programme में tobacco module, (2) Enforcement coordination with police/municipality, (3) Tobacco cessation counselling training for ANMs/ASHAs, (4) District data compilation. India — 1.3 million tobacco-related deaths/year।

question: भारत में 'National Programme for Non-Communicable Diseases (NP-NCD)' के अंतर्गत कौन-कौन से कार्यक्रम आते हैं और HEO की क्या भूमिका है?

options.text: NCD — केवल diabetes और hypertension है
NP-NCD: NPCDCS (cardiovascular, diabetes, cancer, stroke), NTCP, NACP-NCD, NPCB, NMHP, NPPCD — HEO: community NCD screening camps, CPHC 30+ population screening, data, IEC
NCD programs — separate से चलते हैं, HEO की role नहीं
India में NCDs — fully controlled हो गए हैं

explanation: National Programme for Non-Communicable Diseases (NP-NCD) — NHM umbrella: (1) NPCDCS (National Programme for Cancer, Diabetes, CVD and Stroke) — population-based screening, CHO-led at HWC, (2) NTCP (tobacco), (3) NACP (alcohol/substance — NIMHANS), (4) NPCB (National Programme for Control of Blindness — cataract camps), (5) NMHP (mental health), (6) NPPCD (National Programme for Prevention and Control of Deafness). NCD Burden: 60%+ of deaths. CPHC focus: 30+ years population screening — HbP, DM, 3 common cancers (oral, cervical, breast). HEO role: (1) NCD camp planning and execution, (2) CBAC (Community-Based Assessment Checklist) training for ASHA, (3) Referral pathway strengthening, (4) HMIS NCD data quality, (5) IEC on lifestyle modification।

question: भारत में 'Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)' के अंतर्गत 'Empanelment' की प्रक्रिया और निजी अस्पतालों की accountability क्या है?

options.text: PM-JAY में सभी private hospitals automatically empanelled हैं

Empanelment: minimum criteria (beds, OT, ICU, specialists), NABH accreditation preferred, SHA/DISHA द्वारा inspection → agreement → TMS (Transaction Management System) में claim; fraud: de-empanelment
PM-JAY — केवल government hospitals के लिए है
PM-JAY hospital billing — unregulated private rate पर है

explanation: PM-JAY (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana / Ayushman Bharat) Hospital Empanelment: (1) Criteria: minimum 10 beds (general ward), OT, ICU, specialist doctors — verified by State Health Agency (SHA) or District Implementing Support Agency (DISHA), (2) NABH accreditation — preferably pre-entry or entry-level, (3) Agreement with SHA — rates fixed (package rates, not market rates), (4) Process: application → inspection → empanelment order → IT system (TMS) integration, (5) Claims: cashless — hospital files online, NHA verifies, pays within 15 days, (6) Accountability: fraud detection — random audits, beneficiary verification, anti-fraud unit (National Anti-Fraud Unit — NAFU), (7) Penalty: de-empanelment, recovery, blacklisting. Over 27,000 hospitals empanelled (2024). Package rates defined — hospitals cannot charge more।

question: भारत में 'Nikshay Poshan Yojana' और TB elimination में DBT का क्या योगदान है?

options.text: Nikshay — केवल TB registration portal है
Nikshay Poshan Yojana (2018): TB patients को ₹500/month nutritional support — DBT directly to account; nutrition → treatment adherence → cure rate; National TB Elimination Programme (2025 target)
TB treatment — India में सशुल्क है
Nikshay — private hospitals को monitor नहीं करता

explanation: Nikshay Poshan Yojana (NPY) 2018: TB-nutrition nexus — malnutrition → TB susceptibility; TB → worsening nutrition. DBT: ₹500/month directly to notified TB patient's Aadhaar-linked bank account for duration of treatment. Nikshay portal (nikshay.in): (1) All TB cases (public + private) notified, (2) Treatment tracking, (3) NPY payment status. National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP): Eliminate TB by 2025 (WHO target 2030). Additional support: Ni-kshay Mitra (donor support for food baskets, nutritional supplements). Private sector notification mandatory under PCPNR Act 2013. CBAC: community screening for TB symptoms. Diagnosis: Free NAAT (molecular test) at DR-TB labs. India — 28% of global TB burden। Government provides: free diagnosis, free treatment (FDC — Fixed Dose Combination drugs)।

question: भारत में 'National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme (NVBDCP)' की governance structure और primary healthcare में इसकी क्या भूमिका है?

options.text: NVBDCP — केवल malaria के लिए है

NVBDCP: malaria, dengue, chikungunya, kala-azar, filaria, JE/AES — integrated vector control; District Malaria Officer; ASHA peripheral surveillance; PHC diagnosis + treatment; National Framework for Malaria Elimination (2027 target)
Vector-borne diseases — only urban problem
NVBDCP — WHO द्वारा operate किया जाता है

explanation: National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme (NVBDCP) — NHM component: Diseases covered: (1) Malaria, (2) Dengue + Chikungunya, (3) Kala-azar (Visceral Leishmaniasis), (4) Lymphatic Filariasis (elephantiasis), (5) Japanese Encephalitis/Acute Encephalitis Syndrome (JE/AES). Governance: District Malaria Officer (DMO) → Block level → PHC → ASHA. ASHA role: malaria RDT (Rapid Diagnostic Test), treat Pv malaria (Chloroquine), refer Pf cases. National Framework for Malaria Elimination (NFME) 2016-2030: eliminate by 2027. Kala-azar Elimination: target <1 case/10,000 population at block level. IRS (Indoor Residual Spraying), LLIN (Long Lasting Insecticidal Nets), larval source management. ASHA: fever surveillance, blood slide collection। HEO: IEC on vector control, cooler/container clearance campaigns।

question: भारत में 'National Programme for Control of Blindness and Visual Impairment (NPCB&VI)' की प्रमुख विशेषताएं और district-level implementation क्या है?

options.text: NPCB — केवल cataract surgery तक सीमित है
NPCB&VI: cataract, refractive error, low vision, diabetic retinopathy, childhood blindness, corneal blindness — District Blindness Control Society (DBCS); mobile ophthalmic units; school screening
Blindness control — private sector की जिम्मेदारी है
India में blindness — completely eliminated हो गई है

explanation: National Programme for Control of Blindness and Visual Impairment (NPCB&VI) — NHM component: Causes: cataract (66%), refractive error, corneal blindness, glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy. District Blindness Control Society (DBCS): registered society — similar to RKS model. Key initiatives: (1) Cataract surgeries (target: 7 million/year), (2) School eye screening — RBSK linkage, (3) Free spectacle distribution to children + elderly, (4) Mobile Ophthalmic Units in tribal areas, (5) Diabetic retinopathy screening at NCD clinics, (6) National Blindness Survey (2015-19): blindness 1.99% (reduced from 8.9% in 1971). PPP model: government empanels ophthalmologists, NGO hospitals (Arvind Eye Care, LV Prasad). HEO role: camp organisation, transport, RBSK school screening coordination, cataract camp IEC।

question: भारत में 'Universal Immunization Programme (UIP)' के Mission Indradhanush 2.0 और 3.0 में क्या नया था?

options.text: Mission Indradhanush — 2015 में पूर्ण हो गया था
MI 2.0 (2019-20): hard-to-reach + urban slum areas में intense focus; MI 3.0 (2021): COVID disruption recovery — 8 new vaccines, ILR (cold chain), eVIN tracking, AEFI monitoring
MI — केवल polio eradication के लिए था
UIP में 10 से अधिक vaccines नहीं हैं

explanation: Universal Immunization Programme (UIP) — India 1985 से। Mission Indradhanush (MI) 2014 — 'catch-up' immunization for missed children. MI 2.0 (Intensified, 2019-20): (1) Hard-to-reach, conflict-affected, urban slum areas focus, (2) 272 districts covered, (3) Anti-vaxxer communities. MI 3.0 (2021) — post-COVID recovery: (1) August-October 2021 — 3 rounds, (2) 250 districts, (3) Recovery from COVID disruption (immunization dropped 40% in 2020). New vaccines added to UIP (over years): Rotavirus, IPV, MR (Measles-Rubella), PCV (Pneumococcal Conjugate), MenA, JE. eVIN (Electronic Vaccine Intelligence Network) — real-time cold chain monitoring. AEFI surveillance — Adverse Events Following Immunization. Full immunization: 76.4% (NFHS-5 2021 vs 62% NFHS-4). U-WIN (UIP digital platform) — beneficiary registration।

question: भारत में 'Adolescent Health Programme — RKSK (Rashtriya Kishor Swasthya Karyakram)' की क्या विशेषताएं हैं और यह पूर्ववर्ती ARSH से कैसे भिन्न है?

options.text: RKSK — केवल लड़कियों के लिए है
RKSK (2014): 10-19 वर्ष (किशोर + किशोरी दोनों), 6 थीम — nutrition, SRHR, mental health, substance abuse, NCDs, injuries; Peer Education model; AFHC; WIFS — ARSH से व्यापक
RKSK — ARSH का ही दूसरा नाम है
RKSK — केवल school-based programme है

explanation: Rashtriya Kishor Swasthya Karyakram (RKSK) 2014 — replaces ARSH (Adolescent Reproductive and Sexual Health) 2005. Differences: (1) Coverage: ARSH — 10-19 girls focus; RKSK — both boys and girls 10-19 years, (2) Themes: ARSH — mainly SRHR; RKSK — 6 themes: Nutrition, SRHR (Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights), Mental health, Substance abuse, NCDs, Non-intentional injuries and violence, (3) Peer Educator model: trained adolescent peers in school and community, (4) AFHC (Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics) at PHC/CHC — counsellor, 1 day/week, (5) WIFS (Weekly Iron and Folic Acid Supplementation) — institutional + community, (6) MHM (Menstrual Hygiene). Out-of-school adolescents also targeted. Adolescent nutrition — a key gap. SABLA → POSHAN Abhiyaan for girls 14-18।

question: भारत में 'National Programme for Health Care of Elderly (NPHCE)' की क्या आवश्यकता है और primary care में इसे कैसे integrate किया जाता है?

options.text: Elderly care — family की जिम्मेदारी, government program नहीं
NPHCE (2010): 60+ आयु; dedicated OPD in DH/CHC, geriatric ward, home-based elderly care (ASHA), SEHAT (awareness), Regional Geriatric Centres (RGC) — PHC level पर elderly-friendly services
NPHCE — केवल urban hospitals में है
India में elderly population — healthcare priority नहीं है

explanation: National Programme for Health Care of Elderly (NPHCE) 2010 (MoHFW): Context: India 104 million elderly (60+); 2050 — 300 million projected. Key features: (1) District Hospital: Geriatric OPD (dedicated weekly day), 10-bed geriatric ward, physiotherapy, (2) CHC: Geriatric day-care, (3) PHC: training of MO and parastaff, (4) Home-based: ASHA visits elderly monthly (HBNC extended), identifies functional decline, (5) SEHAT awareness programme, (6) Regional Geriatric Centres (8 AIIMS + medical colleges) — training + referral, (7) Long-term care: linkage with Ministry of Social Justice schemes (NSAP pension). Challenges: (1) Doctor shortages, (2) No dedicated geriatric cadre, (3) Community isolation. HEO: elderly register maintenance, monthly ASHA visit verification, linkage to social protection schemes।

question: भारत में 'Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)' की eligibility, benefit और implementation challenges क्या हैं?

options.text: PMMVY — सभी mothers को मिलती है, unlimited बच्चों के लिए
PMMVY (2017): first living child के लिए ₹5000 (3 किस्त — ANC, delivery, 6-month breastfeeding), Aadhaar-DBT; institutional delivery + breastfeeding को incentivize करता है
PMMVY — केवल BPL महिलाओं के लिए है
PMMVY — JSY का ही अंग है

explanation: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) — under PMMVVY Act 2017 (maternity benefit): (1) Beneficiary: all pregnant/lactating women for first living child (19+ years); excludes govt employees with paid maternity leave, (2) Benefit: ₹5000 in 3 installments: ₹1000 (early ANC registration), ₹2000 (after 1 ANC — 6 months), ₹2000 (after 14 weeks + breastfeeding/nutrition counselling), (3) Additional benefit: JSY ₹1000 for institutional delivery → total ₹6000, (4) DBT: Aadhaar-linked bank account, (5) PMMVY-CAS: Common Application Software for tracking. Implementation challenges: (1) Second child excluded (gender imbalance criticism), (2) Aadhaar linkage exclusions, (3) Low awareness, (4) Bank account access. PMMVY 2.0 (2022): second girl child also ₹6000 conditional (incentivize girl child)।

question: 'Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)' और 'JSY' के बीच क्या अंतर है और JSSK के तहत क्या entitlements हैं?

options.text: JSSK और JSY — एक ही program हैं

JSY — cash transfer (mother को); JSSK (2011) — cashless entitlement: free delivery, C-section, drugs, diagnostics, diet, blood, transport, newborn services — government hospital में 'zero expense' delivery
JSSK — private hospitals में भी applicable है
JSSK — केवल C-section deliveries के लिए है

explanation: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK) 2011: Concept — 'zero expense' delivery at government health facility. Entitlements for pregnant women: (1) Free delivery (normal + C-section), (2) Free drugs and consumables, (3) Free diagnostics (blood test, ultrasound), (4) Free blood, (5) Free diet (3 days normal, 7 days C-section), (6) Free transport (home to facility + facility to referral + back home), (7) Free treatment for sick newborn (0-30 days): drugs, diagnostics, diet, blood, transport. JSY vs JSSK: JSY = conditional cash incentive to mother for institutional delivery; JSSK = cashless service guarantee in government hospital. Combined effect: institutional delivery — 89% (NFHS-5 2021). HEO role: JSSK entitlement awareness, IEC, ensuring facilities are stocked with JSSK requirements।

question: भारत में 'Ayushman Bharat — CPHC (Comprehensive Primary Health Care)' का design क्या है और यह secondary/tertiary care से कैसे link है?

options.text: CPHC — केवल sub-centre transformation है
CPHC: HWC-based 12-service packages + PMJAY referral linkage — preventive + promotive + curative continuum; CHO at HWC, referral to PMJAY-empanelled hospitals — two pillars of Ayushman Bharat
CPHC — केवल NCD management करता है
Ayushman Bharat — केवल PM-JAY insurance है

explanation: Ayushman Bharat — Comprehensive Primary Health Care (CPHC): Pillar 1 of Ayushman Bharat scheme. Design: (1) 1,50,000+ Health and Wellness Centres (HWCs) by 2022 — Sub-Centres (SHC-HWCs) and PHC-HWCs, (2) 12 service packages: Maternal health, Child health, Adolescent health, Family Planning, Elderly care, Mental health, Oral health, Eye care, ENT, NCD screening, Palliative, Emergency. Community Health Officer (CHO) — B.Sc. Community Health (2-year bridge course). Linkage with PM-JAY (Pillar 2): referral → empanelled hospital → cashless secondary/tertiary. CPHC → PM-JAY continuum: prevents unnecessary tertiary care, gate-keeping. CPHC benefits: (1) Reduces OOP at primary level, (2) Early NCD detection, (3) Preventive health focus. NHM provides staff, drugs, diagnostics at HWCs।

question: भारत में 'Central Council of Health and Family Welfare' की क्या भूमिका है और यह health policy में किस प्रकार कार्य करती है?

options.text: CCHFW — केवल advisory body है, कोई authority नहीं
CCHFW (अनुच्छेद — non-constitutional, statutory/convention): health policy सिफारिशें, National Health Policy draft करती है, Centre-State health coordination — health ministers' conference
CCHFW — Parliament द्वारा directly run होती है
CCHFW — constitutional body है जैसे Finance Commission

explanation: Central Council of Health and Family Welfare (CCHFW): Established under Section 3 of the Pharmacy Act 1948 and reconstituted by Resolution. Not a constitutional body — statutory convention body. Composition: Union Health Minister (Chairman), State Health Ministers, Chief Ministers (optional), technical experts. Functions: (1) National Health Policy formulation recommendations (NHP 1983, 2002, 2017), (2) Coordination of health policies between Centre and States, (3) Minimum standards — medical education, essential services, (4) Recommendations on legislation. Meets periodically (ideally annually, but irregular). Distinct from ICMR (research), NMC (medical education), MCI (replaced). Health Ministers' Conference — equivalent consultative forum. CCHFW recommendations → Cabinet for NHP approval।

question: भारत में 'National Health Accounts (NHA)' framework क्या है और यह health financing policy में कैसे उपयोगी है?

options.text: NHA — केवल government health expenditure account है

NHA (System of Health Accounts 2011): सभी health financing flows — government, private, OOP, insurance, donor; Total Health Expenditure (THE) और OOP tracking; India 2019-20: THE 1.96% GDP — policy baseline
NHA — IMF द्वारा prepare की जाती है
NHA — केवल hospitalisation expenditure count करती है

explanation: National Health Accounts (NHA) — India: Follows SHA 2011 (System of Health Accounts) — WHO/OECD/Eurostat framework. Prepared by: National Health Accounts Technical Secretariat (NHATS) under MoHFW. Key metrics: (1) Total Health Expenditure (THE) as % of GDP: India 2019-20 — 1.96% (goal 2.5%), (2) Government Health Expenditure (GHE) as % of THE: 41.3%, (3) Out-of-Pocket Expenditure (OOPE): 47.1% of THE (reducing — was 62% in 2015-16), (4) External Aid: <1%. Policy relevance: (1) Monitors progress toward 2.5% GDP target (NHP 2017), (2) Tracks OOP reduction (OOPE reduction → UHC progress), (3) Guides budget allocations, (4) 15th Finance Commission condition: states must publish NHA. State Health Accounts (SHA) also developed।

question: भारत में 'IPC Section 312-316' (गर्भपात संबंधी धाराएं) और 'MTP Act 1971 Amendment 2021' के बीच क्या संबंध है?

options.text: IPC और MTP Act — विरोधाभासी हैं और दोनों साथ apply नहीं होते
IPC 312-316: abortion — criminal; MTP Act 1971 provides legal exceptions — medical termination conditions; 2021 Amendment: 24 weeks limit, unmarried women included, MTP Boards for special cases
MTP Act 2021 — abortion को fully decriminalized किया
IPC 312 — MTP Act के बाद repeal हो गई

explanation: IPC and Abortion: IPC Sections 312-316 — abortion = criminal offense (with exceptions). MTP Act 1971 (Medical Termination of Pregnancy) creates legal space: abortion permitted if: (1) Pregnancy endangers life/physical/mental health, (2) Contraceptive failure (married women initially, now all women), (3) Fetal abnormality. MTP Amendment Act 2021: Key changes: (1) Gestational limit: 20 weeks → 24 weeks for special categories (rape survivors, differently abled, minors), (2) Single-doctor opinion: up to 20 weeks (was 12 weeks), (3) Unmarried women also included for contraceptive failure clause, (4) Medical Boards: for >24 weeks cases (fetal abnormality), (5) Confidentiality: providers cannot reveal identity. IPC 312 still exists — not repealed — MTP Act provides exception. Reproductive rights — Art. 21 (privacy judgment)।

question: भारत में 'Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques Act 1994 (PCPNDT Act)' का enforcement mechanism और sex ratio at birth में इसका क्या प्रभाव है?

options.text: PCPNDT Act — sex selective abortion को पूरी तरह रोकने में सफल रहा है

PCPNDT Act: ultrasound machines registration + form F + monitoring board; 2003 Amendment: portable machines covered; Beti Bachao Beti Padhao convergence; SRB improvement — limited but visible (919 to 934 NFHS-5)
PCPNDT Act — sex determination को legal बनाता है
PCPNDT Act — DNA testing को regulate करता है

explanation: PCPNDT Act 1994 (Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques Act): Prevents sex-selective abortion through regulation of diagnostic techniques. Provisions: (1) Registration of all genetic centres, ultrasound clinics, (2) Form F: mandatory record of every procedure, (3) Prohibition: revealing sex of fetus — criminal offense (3-5 years imprisonment), (4) Appropriate Authority at District, State, National level, (5) 2003 Amendment: covered pre-conception sex selection, portable ultrasound machines. Monitoring: Decoy operations (fake patient sting), 'Save the Girl Child' campaigns. Challenges: (1) Under-enforcement (Appropriate Authority capacity), (2) Portable machine regulation weak, (3) Prenatal determination in private rooms. SRB (Sex Ratio at Birth): 918 (Census 2011) → 934 (NFHS-5 2021) — improvement but gap remains (ideal: 950+). Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (2015) — convergence with PCPNDT enforcement।

question: भारत में 'Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK)' के 4D screening approach और district-level implementation क्या है?

options.text: RBSK — केवल newborn screening है

RBSK (2013): 0-18 years — 4Ds (Defects at birth, Diseases, Deficiencies, Developmental delays/disabilities) — Mobile Health Teams (MHT) at school/AWC; early intervention; District Early Intervention Centre (DEIC)
RBSK — private schools में compulsory है
RBSK — केवल 0-6 years के लिए है

explanation: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK) 2013 — Child Health Screening and Early Intervention: Target: 0-18 years (0-6 at AWC, 6-18 at school). 4D approach: (1) Defects at birth (congenital heart disease, cleft lip/palate, NTDs, talipes, developmental dysplasia of hip), (2) Diseases (sickle cell, TB, dental caries, vision, hearing), (3) Deficiencies (malnutrition, anemia, IDD, Vitamin D), (4) Developmental delays/disabilities (autism, ADHD, cerebral palsy, learning disability). Mobile Health Teams (MHT): 2 AYUSH doctors + pharmacist + ANM + vision technician — school visits. DEIC (District Early Intervention Centre): specialist referral point. Free treatment for detected conditions (PM-JAY convergence for high-cost conditions). HEO: MHT coordination, school-AWC scheduling, DEIC referral management।

question: भारत में 'Health and Wellness Centre' पर तैनात 'Community Health Officer (CHO)' की क्या योग्यता और अधिकार हैं?

options.text: CHO — MBBS doctor होते हैं

CHO: B.Sc. Community Health (2-year bridge course) graduates — 12-package CPHC delivery, limited prescribing rights for common ailments, NCD screening, ASHA supervision — HWC को functionally upgrade करते हैं
CHO — ANM का ही दूसरा designation है
CHO — केवल NHM के data entry करते हैं

explanation: Community Health Officer (CHO): New cadre under Ayushman Bharat CPHC. Qualification: B.Sc. Community Health — 2-year bridge course (developed by NMC/NHSRC) — diploma/BSc science graduates eligible. Training institutions: Community Health Provider programme. Scope of practice: (1) 12 CPHC service packages delivery, (2) Limited prescribing: common ailments (ORS, paracetamol, OCP, iron-folic acid, antibiotics for RTI, etc.) — under supervision protocol, (3) NCD screening: CBAC, hypertension/diabetes protocol, (4) ASHA supervision and mentoring, (5) HMIS data entry and quality, (6) Jan Arogya Samiti (JAS) secretariat support, (7) Teleconsultation facilitation. Controversy: IMA opposed prescribing rights — 'backdoor MBBS.' States deploying: HP, Chhattisgarh, UP, Assam. Shortage of doctors → CHO as solution।

question: भारत में 'National Nutrition Mission (POSHAN Abhiyaan) 2.0' में क्या बदलाव किए गए और 'Poshan Tracker' की क्या भूमिका है?

options.text: POSHAN Abhiyaan 2.0 — 1.0 से identical है
POSHAN 2.0 (2021): ICDS + PMMVY + anganwadi services merge; Poshan Tracker app — AWW real-time growth monitoring; beneficiary-centric; adolescent girls (SAG) added; diet diversity focus
POSHAN 2.0 — केवल WCD Ministry का program है, health ministry का नहीं
Poshan Tracker — government employees के लिए nutrition app है

explanation: POSHAN Abhiyaan 2.0 (2021-26): Merges: (1) Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS), (2) PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY), (3) Anganwadi Services — into unified scheme. New elements: (1) Adolescent Girls (SAG) — 14-18 years, out-of-school: nutrition, health, life skills at Anganwadi, (2) Diet Diversity: beyond just calories — micronutrient-rich foods, (3) Poshan Tracker App: replaces ICDS-CAS — AWW records weight, height, MUAC on mobile, real-time dashboard, (4) Poshan Maah (September) + Poshan Pakhwada (15 days), (5) Convergence: 8 ministries. Targets: reduce stunting 2%/year, wasting 2%/year, anemia 3%/year. NFHS-5: stunting 35.5%, wasting 19.3%, anemia 67% in children <5 — still high。 HEO: POSHAN Maah activities, AWC visits, VHND linkage।

question: भारत में 'National Urban Health Mission (NUHM)' की क्या आवश्यकता थी और urban slum health governance में इसका क्या योगदान है?

options.text: Urban health — केवल private sector की जिम्मेदारी है
NUHM (2013): शहरी गरीबों, slum dwellers के लिए — Urban Health Resource Centres (UHRC), ANM + ASHA (Urban ASHA/MAHILA AROGYA SAMITI), Mohalla Clinic concept, ULB-health integration
NUHM — NHM में merge होने के बाद बंद हो गया
NUHM — केवल metro cities के लिए है

explanation: National Urban Health Mission (NUHM) 2013: Context — rapid urbanization; urban poor/slum dwellers face double burden (communicable + NCD) but excluded from rural NHM. Merged into NHM 2014 as urban component. Key features: (1) Urban Health Resource Centres (UHRC) — equivalent to Sub-Centre in urban slum area, (2) Urban ASHA/Link Worker: community mobilizer in slum, (3) Mahila Arogya Samiti (MAS): urban equivalent of VHSNC, (4) Target: cities with >50,000 population, (5) ULB (Urban Local Bodies) role: health service delivery, (6) Delhi's Mohalla Clinics (2015) — inspired by NUHM PHC model. Challenges: (1) Floating population (migrants), (2) ULB capacity, (3) Coordination between municipal health and state NHM, (4) Urban ASHA payment regularity. HEO in urban context: slum health mapping, MAS activation, IEC in migrant communities।

question: भारत में 'Pradhan Mantri TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan' और 'Ni-kshay Mitra' initiative क्या है?

options.text: यह TB patients को निःशुल्क hospitalize करने की scheme है

PM TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan (2022): individuals/organisations (Ni-kshay Mitras) — TB patients को nutritional, diagnostic, vocational support adopt करें; community participation through elected representatives, corporates, NGOs
Ni-kshay Mitra — ASHA workers का दूसरा नाम है
PM TB Mukt Bharat — केवल MDR-TB patients के लिए है

explanation: Pradhan Mantri TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan (2022, launched September 9): India's 2025 TB elimination goal requires community participation. Ni-kshay Mitra concept: (1) Donors (individuals, NGOs, corporates, elected representatives) adopt TB patients — minimum 1 TB patient for 1 treatment period, (2) Support provided: nutritional support (food basket ₹500-1000/month), diagnostics, vocational training, emotional support, (3) Ni-kshay portal integration — donor-patient matching, (4) Target: engage MPs (adopt district), MLAs (block), gram panchayat heads. Connection with Nikshay Poshan Yojana: NPY gives govt cash (₹500/month); Ni-kshay Mitra provides community support additionally. Political dimensions: elected representatives take ownership. HEO role: coordinate Ni-kshay Mitra program in district, organize adoption events।

question: भारत में 'ASHA programme' की national-level governance और 'ASHA Mentoring Group' की क्या भूमिका है?

options.text: ASHA — केवल state governments द्वारा manage होती हैं

MoHFW — ASHA national guidelines, incentive structure; State — recruitment, training, deployment; NHSRC ASHA Resource Centre — technical support; ASHA Mentoring Group — quality improvement, interstate learning
WHO — ASHA program को design किया था
ASHA — district hospitals में तैनात होती हैं

explanation: ASHA Governance Structure: (1) National Level: MoHFW — ASHA guidelines (selection, training, incentives), NHSRC (ASHA Resource Centre — ARC): technical support, training materials, documentation, (2) State Level: State Health Society — recruitment (1 ASHA/1000 population in rural areas), deployment, training calendar, incentive payment, (3) District Level: CMO office — ASHA training, monthly meetings, incentive processing, (4) Block Level: ASHA facilitator (1 per 20 ASHAs) — mentoring, problem-solving, (5) Village Level: ASHA — VHSNC Secretary, community mobilization. ASHA Mentoring Group (National): (1) Annual conference of state ASHA program managers, (2) Interstate learning, best practices, (3) NHSRC facilitation, (4) Guidelines revision. Data: 1.02 million ASHAs (2023). Quality: annual ASHA survey (NHSRC)。

question: भारत में 'Digital Health' policy framework — 'National Digital Health Mission (ABDM)' के चार building blocks क्या हैं और इनकी health governance में क्या भूमिका है?

options.text: ABDM — केवल Ayushman Bharat health insurance का digital platform है
ABDM (2021): ABHA (health ID), Health Facility Registry, Healthcare Professional Registry, Health Claims Exchange — unified digital health ecosystem; interoperability, portability, patient-centricity
ABDM — केवल government hospitals के लिए है
Digital health — India में अभी प्रारंभिक चरण में भी नहीं है

explanation: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) 2021 — National Health Authority: Building blocks: (1) ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) — unique 14-digit Health ID for every citizen — links all health records, (2) Health Facility Registry (HFR) — all public + private health facilities digitally registered with unique ID, (3) Healthcare Professional Registry (HPR) — all doctors, nurses, paramedics digitally registered (linked to ABHA), (4) Health Claims Exchange (HCX) — interoperable insurance claim processing. Additional: PHR (Personal Health Records) app — patient controls own records. Interoperability: ABHA links records across providers — physician change — continuity of care. Privacy: Data Protection Bill alignment. NHP 2017 — digital health envisioned. COVID vaccination (CoWIN) → early ABDM precursor। HEO: ABHA enrollment camps, facility registration support, HFR verification।

question: भारत में 'Mission Parivar Vikas (MPV)' किन जिलों में और क्यों लागू किया गया और इसकी प्रमुख रणनीतियाँ क्या हैं?

options.text: Mission Parivar Vikas — पूरे भारत में equally apply होता है

MPV (2016): 7 high-TFR states (UP, Bihar, MP, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Assam) के 146 जिले — contraceptive basket विस्तार, नई contraceptive methods (injectable, centchroman), ASHA प्रोत्साहन, नवदम्पति सम्पर्क
MPV — compulsory family planning scheme है
MPV — केवल urban couples के लिए है

explanation: Mission Parivar Vikas (MPV) 2016 (MoHFW): Context — India's TFR 2.0 (national average 2021) but 7 states still above replacement (TFR 3+). Target: 146 high-TFR districts in 7 states (UP, Bihar, MP, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Assam). Strategies: (1) Expanded contraceptive basket: injectable contraceptive (Antara — MPA, 3-monthly injection), Centchroman (Chhaya — weekly pill), condoms, IUCDs, OCPs — all free at PHC, (2) Naya Saathi: new entrant contraceptive counsellor, (3) ASHA incentives for contraceptive uptake, (4) Nayi Pahel Kit: newlywed couple welcome kit (contraceptives + information), (5) Saas Bahu Sammelans: mother-in-law + daughter-in-law meetings for family planning awareness, (6) Contraceptive sabbatical: improving quality, reducing sterilization dependence. Key principle: rights-based, target-free, voluntary — NPP 2000 framework। HMIS tracking of modern contraceptive prevalence rate (mCPR)।
